leads.title: Islamic Penal Code of Iran - 2013 version
leads.documents: Criminalization and punishments for same-sex sexual activity; defines sodomy (lavat), intercrural sex, intimate acts between men, tribadism, repentance/pardon rules
leads.detail: Cited as Articles 233, 234, 235, 237, 238, 239, 114, 136; noted as preceded by Islamic Penal Code of 1991, pre-Revolutionary Penal Code of 1973 as amended by penal bills of 1982. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Iranian Civil Code Article 215 and birth certification provision Article 20 Clause 14
leads.documents: Legal mechanism for sex reassignment surgery as rational benefit and for legal change of name and gender on birth certification upon court order with medical approval
leads.detail: Cited as Article 215 of civil code and Article 20 in Clause 14 requiring court order. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Fatwas by Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini - 1964, 1983, reaffirmed 1985
leads.documents: Religious-legal approval permitting sex reassignment operations as cure for diagnosed transsexuals, basis for legalization since mid-1980s
leads.detail: Cited as 1964 fatwa while in exile, 1983 fatwa, 1985 reaffirmation. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: The Boroumand Foundation
leads.documents: Records of executions with charges related to homosexuality in post-revolutionary period
leads.detail: Cited for records of at least 107 executions with charges related to homosexuality between 1979 and 1990. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amnesty International
leads.documents: Execution of people convicted of homosexual activity under government policy demanding executions of those who practice homosexuality
leads.detail: Cited for male homosexual executed in January 1990 under unclear circumstances and at least five people - three men and two women - executed in January 1990. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Human Rights Watch
leads.documents: Enforcement raid and detention on suspicion of homosexual activity
leads.detail: Cited for February 2008 police in Isfahan raided party in private home and arrested 30 men held indefinitely without lawyer on suspicion of homosexual activity. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Iranian Railroad for Queer Refugees (IRQR) - Toronto-based
leads.documents: May 2007 Isfahan crackdown, beating and detention of suspected gay men
leads.detail: Cited for May 10, 2007 Isfahan police arrested 87 people at birthday party including 80 suspected gay men, beating and detaining through weekend; photos of beaten men released. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: United States Department of State - Country Reports on Human Rights Practices 2017
leads.documents: Official US human-rights assessment: law criminalizes consensual same-sex activity punishable by death/flogging, no anti-discrimination protection, harassment/arrests/raids, summary trials for sodomy
leads.detail: Cited as Country Reports on Human Rights Practices of 2017 section Acts of Violence, Discrimination, and Other Abuses Based on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: IRNA (Islamic Republic News Agency) - September 5, 2022 report
leads.documents: Death sentences for LGBTQ rights activists Zahra Seddiqi Hamedani and Elham Choubdar on charges of corruption on earth and human trafficking
leads.detail: Cited as IRNA September 5, 2022 report; sentence confirmed by judiciary, EU condemned September 13, 2022; Choubdar sentence later overturned by Supreme Court. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Etemad daily newspaper - March 15, 2005 report
leads.documents: Tehran Criminal Court death sentences for consensual sodomy based on video and confession
leads.detail: Cited as Etemad March 15, 2005: Tehran Criminal Court sentenced two men to death following discovery of video showing them engaged in sexual acts to which they confessed. No URL visible in text.
